name: Dr. Friderike Bruchmann
headline: Co-Founder & CEO at XO Life | Enabling better Patient Education, Treatment Support and Real World Evidence 🌎 | Tech Newcomer by Handelsblatt and Federal Ministry of Economics
summary:
I am the founder and CEO of XO Life: We have built brite, a holistic digital health platform that enables patients to manage therapies, medications, and health information in one central place. brite connects patients, healthcare providers, and life science companies, offering personalized medical information, AI-powered guidance, reminders, and secure communities — everything needed for a seamless, trusted, and continuous patient journey.

For life science companies, XO Life provides an innovative digital service to strengthen patient and customer engagement. Each manufacturer can create a customized, branded companion on brite, helping patients while generating valuable insights. 
Today, XO Life is already market leader in Germany and our brite platform is used across Europe, Africa, and the UAE, partnering with over 40 manufacturers to deliver truly patient-centered, digital-first healthcare experiences.

company.description:
XO Life stands for
✅ a state-of-the-art platform solution for long-term Patient Insights from the real world
✅ real time information exchange between patients and pharma
✅ a all-in-one platform to be used across all treatments and indications

We are a young and dynamic eHealth company setting a new standard patient data collection through scientifically based questionnaires across all treatments and medications.

XO Life helps the pharmaceutical industry to better understand its patients. Our goal is to make digital treatment monitoring and patient feedback the gold standard in R&D, marketing and sales, while ensuring the highest data protection and security standards.
